name: agile-sofl-monorepo
description: Agile-SOFL monorepo: parser, language server, editor API, VS Code extension, and Studio

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agile-sofl/parser && npm run build --workspace @agile-sofl/gui && npm run build --workspace @agile-sofl/aspec && npm run build --workspace @agile-sofl/editor-api && npm run build --workspace @agile-sofl/language-server && npm run build --workspace agile-sofl --if-present && npm run build --workspace @agile-sofl/studio --if-present
scripts.build:editor-stack: npm run build && npm run build --prefix packages/language-server && node packages/language-server/scripts/bundle.mjs && node packages/vscode/scripts/copy-lsp-server.mjs && npm run build --prefix packages/vscode
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @agile-sofl/parser && npm run test --workspace @agile-sofl/gui && npm run test --workspace @agile-sofl/aspec && npm run test --workspace @agile-sofl/editor-api && npm run test --workspace @agile-sofl/language-server && npm run test --workspace agile-sofl --if-present && npm run test --workspace @agile-sofl/studio --if-present
